steps.what: Interpret non-destructive testing results in their material, method and acquisition context

tasks.design: Keep indication interpretation with the specialist, using {OTHER}, the test-instrument viewer, and procedures in {DOCS}. No automated defect classification is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: An indication's meaning depends on method, material and acquisition conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instrument views support interpretation; the digest provides no validated all-method interpretation capability.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing real discontinuities from artefacts and recognising inadequate coverage.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist connects the signal to physical testing conditions and identifies uncertainty.

reach.task: Explain component material and manufacturing context

evidence.claim: Contextual NDT interpretation remains specialist judgement; test-report generation does not establish automated interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is technical interpretation of indications; code-based acceptance evaluation is the separate task below.

The test operator produces raw records, component identity, method, settings and acquisition conditions. Specialist checks these within s1 and records interpreted indications and limitations; no ready defect or safety flag is assumed.
Use existing instrument viewing tools first.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new interpretation engine is introduced.
unknowns: Methods and component types in scope
research_questions: Which interpretation errors arise from inadequate acquisition context?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Physical-context interpretation is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate interpreted results against applicable requirements

steps.what: Select applicable codes and verify interpreted results, units and acceptance criteria
Compare verified test results with the selected explicit numerical acceptance criteria
Evaluate the comparisons, resolve exceptions and record the code-based testing conclusion

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, a controlled numerical comparison tool, for explicitly selected acceptance criteria. The specialist verifies applicability from {DOCS} and retains the final evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated numerical comparisons can be mixed with the separate judgement about which criteria apply.
tasks.enabler_now: A small tested rule table can repeat explicit comparisons without interpreting standards or classifying raw indications.
tasks.still_hard: Code applicability, qualitative provisions, measurement uncertainty and exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides whether the evidence and selected requirements support the conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Spend less effort repeating comparisons while retaining acceptance judgement.

reach.task: Confirm the controlled specification and evaluation remit

evidence.claim: Explicit numerical acceptance comparisons can be coded; applicability and the NDT conclusion remain specialist decisions.

assumptions: Boundary starts with interpreted indications produced in the preceding task; interpretation is not repeated or saved here.

In s1 the specialist checks and records component identity, method, indication dimensions and units, uncertainty, code and revision, clause, threshold, comparison operator and applicability. These exact fields feed s2; missing fields or qualitative criteria stop for manual evaluation in s3.
Test native inspection-rule configuration first; existing automatic comparisons earn no new labour saving.
No raw signal becomes a free structured defect, severity or safety flag; its producer and interpretation are outside this evaluation boundary and counted in that task.
unknowns: Share of evaluation based on explicit numerical criteria
research_questions: Can controlled comparison rules match independent specialist calculations without hiding applicability exceptions?

already_counted.description: Criteria selection, verified field capture and final evaluation

incremental.description: Review changed criteria and maintain independent comparison checks
Maintain controlled tool versions and regression checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact interpreted-result snapshot, selected code revision and clauses, comparisons, exceptions and conclusion; any change requires renewed evaluation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+35=70; gross 30 minus focal upkeep 8 gives net 22 in an E1 scenario. Range 0-4 allows qualitative criteria, existing native comparisons and frequent specification changes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect and verify test-result references, component details and accepted evaluation conclusions
Prepare reports by merging verified testing fields, figures and exact accepted conclusions
Check the complete testing report against source records and approve the prepared version

tasks.design: Configure {OTHER}, a test-recording and reporting system, to assemble verified fields and attachments into a controlled report in {DOCS}. Keep complete source-to-report checking with the specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test metadata, figures and accepted conclusions can be copied repeatedly into report templates.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest describes test-recording software that produces document reports.
tasks.still_hard: Correct component linkage, complete coverage, limitations and ensuring conclusions match the accepted evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist checks that the report accurately represents what was tested and concluded.
tasks.altitude: Reduce report assembly while preserving evidence and review.

reach.task: Confirm report acceptance and release requirements
reach.learn: Which attachments and limitations must remain visible

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces PDF or Word reports; that capability does not establish NDT interpretation or certification.
The saving estimate is an unmeasured report-assembly scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing and internally approving the report, not performing the test, evaluating indications again or externally releasing a certificate.

The test operator produces raw records and acquisition metadata; evaluation task produces accepted conclusions. In s1 the specialist verifies and captures job and component identifiers, method, operator, date, procedure revision, equipment and calibration references, result and image references, exact conclusion text and limitations. Missing fields halt assembly for manual completion.
Use native report configuration first; existing automatic report generation earns no saving.
Assembly copies accepted conclusion text exactly and performs no new defect interpretation.
research_questions: Does native report assembly reduce copying while preserving every required reference and limitation?

already_counted.description: Source capture and complete report checking

incremental.description: Maintain controlled templates and sample source-to-report completeness
Maintain report configuration and restricted access

approvals.approved_version: Exact report file, source record versions, attachments and conclusion text; any change invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+30=60; gross 40 minus focal upkeep 7 gives net 33 in an E1 scenario. Range 0-10 allows existing instrument reporting, incompatible exports and complex attachments.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, calibrate and operate testing equipment

steps.what: Select, calibrate and operate equipment for the actual non-destructive testing conditions

tasks.design: Retain equipment selection, calibration and operation with the specialist. Use {OTHER}, the test-instrument controller, and the controlled procedure in {DOCS} during the physical work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Testing requires practical setup, reference checks and adaptation to the actual component.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instrument controls assist operation without replacing the specialist's work.
tasks.still_hard: Access, calibration validity, coupling, coverage and recognising invalid acquisition conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist checks that the equipment and setup can produce meaningful evidence.

reach.task: Clarify required coverage and method constraints
reach.learn: When access or equipment limits require a changed plan

evidence.claim: Instrument reporting capability does not remove physical selection, calibration or testing operation.

assumptions: Boundary is equipment selection, calibration and acquisition; result interpretation and reporting are separate tasks.

Specialist observes conditions and produces component identity, equipment and calibration references, settings and acquisition records within s1. No pre-existing calibration-valid or coverage-complete flag is assumed.
Use existing controller features first; instrument runtime is not human effort.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new testing automation is introduced.
research_questions: Which acquisition problems require physical intervention rather than a reporting change?

already_counted.description: Selection, calibration, operation and setup checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Physical testing and existing controller runtime receive no claimed reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated report and comparison assembly while retaining physical testing and specialist interpretation.
skills_to_grow: Configure reports without losing evidence links
role.ambitious_version: A specialist with reproducible documentation who retains responsibility for valid acquisition, interpretation and evaluation.
